notes.title: Hotfix V.1.1.4 Released (Truck Update)
notes.notes:
Hello, first of all, we would like to apologize for the problems experienced so far with the car. We changed the mechanics of putting products into the truck to minimize problems.

. Now, when you throw the product into the truck, the product sticks to the place it touches, so it does not cloud your driving or the products do not come out of the car.

Here's what was fixed :

- Fixed the issue of small objects flying out of the truck

- The problem where the products in the pickup truck made it undrivable (the car flying, not moving, etc.) has been resolved.

- Small obstacles on the roads that caused fog to the truck have been removed

- The issue of cashiers getting stuck at the door has been resolved

- Fixed the issue where the Katana item did not appear in the storeroom in the arc when you purchased it 

- The problem with Antique Globe product not being sold has been resolved

notes.title: What's News on RELEASE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916459/2c58786cf30003fa81a83ddfaecf206ed5791e08.png

- Storage Wars
    . Immerse yourself in the famous television show. Enter the auction! Join a fierce battle! Find and sell profitable products!

- New City
    . A vast city for you to explore.

- Car
    . It's easier to explore the new city by car!

- Bank
    . Take out a loan! Be careful because if you don't make your payments on time, you may go bankrupt!

- Smuggler
    . The smuggler can find the most suitable products for you! But be careful, the police may fine those who sell illegal products!

- Casino Models Update
    . Casino is now more lively!

- New Casino Games
    . Blackjack: Look at the cards in your hand, keep them according to the table or try your luck!
    . Roulette: Choose your lucky number and wait! Maybe luck will smile on you too!

- Street Seller
    . The goods left by neighbors in the city can also be beautiful! Don't miss it!

- Police
    - From now on, the police will come to inspect from time to time! If you're not selling contraband, you have nothing to fear. If you're selling illegal products, you should smell it!

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 is OUT!
notes.notes:
What's New Added?

- The city has completely changed and new NPC points have been added.
- Restaurant added, human interaction and hunger mechanics coming soon.
- Bank added, credit system coming soon.
- Warehouse battles have been added.
- Now that we have a vehicle, we can drive around the city, bring back warehouses from warehouse battles on our backs and sell them in our shop.

BUGFİX !

- The human population is more stable and organized.
- Sound fixes for Shift key acceleration.
- Interaction key "E" becomes available with "Z" for general use.
- Fixed some absurd situations caused by inverted object interactions.
- Thief mechanics have been made more stable.
- Some dialog fixes.
- Some sound balancing.
- Fixed the popularity system decrease issue.
- Fixed some bugs when switching between tablet menus.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you very much for contacting us and giving us your feedback. In this bug-fix, we hope that we have cleaned up the game-breaking bugs. We may have tested the game hundreds of times, but we are sorry to see that there are still big bugs that we missed. Thanks to you, we are making our game much cleaner and playable. Here is the list of fixed bugs;


ːsteamthumbsupː  Labels glow too much white fixed

ːsteamthumbsupː After saving the game, errors such as placing objects on shelves, holding objects, etc fixed.


ːsteamthumbsupː Store door goes underground fixed


ːsteamthumbsupː Improvement in ragdoll physics


Thanks For Playing
